Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Ready to build intelligent systems at scale? We’re looking for an AI Cloud Developer who can combine cloud engineering expertise with AI innovation to deliver high-impact, production-ready solutions.
 In this role, you’ll work in a Scrum-based, cross-functional team to design, develop, and evolve cloud-native applications enhanced with AI capabilities—owning the full lifecycle from idea and PoC to scalable deployment.
 What You’ll Do 
Design and develop cloud-native applications and services , integrating AI/ML capabilities where they create real value
Deliver solutions aligned with non-functional requirements : scalability, reliability, performance, and security
Collaborate closely with Solution & Domain Architects to shape robust cloud and AI architectures
Build and iterate on Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to validate new ideas and technologies
Apply best practices in cloud security, resilience, and microservices/serverless architectures 
Work hands-on with AI APIs, frameworks, and data flows , ensuring seamless integration
Conduct functional, performance, and resilience testing 
Troubleshoot and optimize distributed cloud and AI systems 
Continuously improve solutions based on metrics, feedback, and evolving best practices 
Ensure compliance with standards, regulations, and internal governance 
 What You Bring 
Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud (certifications are a strong plus)
Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, C# , with hands-on experience using AI APIs and frameworks 
Solid understanding of serverless, microservices, and cloud-native design patterns 
Experience building solutions that meet performance, scalability, and reliability goals 
Strong problem-solving skills, especially in AI-enabled architectures 
Ability to collaborate effectively in Agile, distributed teams 
Curiosity and drive to stay current with the rapidly evolving AI & cloud ecosystem
